sn51.77-86:1.5: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddhambhāgiyānam saṃyojanānam abhiññaya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya cattāro iddhipādā bhāvetabbā ||
sn51.77-86:1.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.77-86:1.11: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddhambhāgiyanaṃ saṃyojanānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ime cattāro iddhipādā bhāvetabbā ti || || Oghavaggo iddhipādavasena vitthāretabbo || || Yadipi satipaṭṭhānā tad api iddhipādaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ || ||
